BlazorPowerPack - Pack & deploy standalone Blazor WebAssembly + Fluent UI apps to Power Pages.

Usage:
  blazor-powerpack <command> [options]
  dnx BlazorPowerPack -- <command> [options]

Commands:
  pack     Pack a Blazor WASM .csproj or published wwwroot/_framework into compressed bundles
  deploy   Build, pack, stage Power Pages metadata, and upload via PAC CLI

Global Options:
  -h, --help      Show help information
  -v, --version   Show version information

Run 'blazor-powerpack <command> --help' for command-specific options.

result.stdout:
Usage:
  blazor-powerpack pack <path> [options]

Arguments:
  <path>                 Path to a Blazor WASM .csproj, project directory, published wwwroot, or _framework

Options:
  -c, --compression <br|gzip>   Bundle compression format (default: br)
  --base-url <url>              Base URL prefix used in patched index.html (default: /_framework)
  --patch-index                 Patch wwwroot/index.html with bootBlazorFromBundles loader
  --configuration <cfg>         MSBuild configuration when <path> is a .csproj/project dir (default: Release)
  -o, --output <dir>            Output directory for published/packed site
  -h, --help                    Show help information

result.stdout:
Usage:
  blazor-powerpack deploy --environment-url <url> --site-name <name-or-guid> [options]

Required Options:
  -e, --environment-url <url>   Power Platform / Dataverse environment URL
  -s, --site-name <name>        Power Pages site name or Website ID (GUID)

Options:
  -p, --project <path>          Path to Blazor WASM .csproj or directory (default: .)
  --configuration <cfg>         MSBuild configuration (default: Release)
  -c, --compression <br|gzip>   Bundle compression format (default: br)
  --model-version <1|2>         Power Pages data model version (default: 2)
  --staging-path <dir>          Local directory for downloaded/staged Power Pages files
  --subfolder <route>           Optional subfolder route for multi-app hosting (e.g. apps/sales)
  --web-template-name <name>    Custom Power Pages Web Template name
  --flatten-to-root             Place _framework files directly under app root instead of /_framework
  --skip-download               Skip 'pac pages download' (offline staging test)
  --skip-upload                 Skip 'pac pages upload' after staging
  -h, --help                    Show help information
